description: M/C of Anuradhapura Draft Budget for the Year 2026
categorisation: The gazette content announces the public inspection period for the draft budget of the Anuradhapura Municipal Council, a local government body. This is an administrative matter related to public finance and local governance procedures. It does not involve central government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any of the specialized categories (Land, Legal, Commercial, Elections, Public Service, or Judicial). Therefore, it falls under the Miscellaneous category for other administrative announcements.
